blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Saint Cecilia’s College (SCC) Maestros showed why they are the defending champions of the Metro Cebu Collegiate Basketball League (MCCBL), clobbering the Cebu Sacred Heart College (CSHC) Hearters, 109-68, in the final elimination-round game on Wednesday at the Cebu City Sports Institute in Sawang Calero. Junrich Caumeran led the Maestros with 17 points, two rebounds, and two assists, while Gevy Eredera added 15 points, seven rebounds, two steals, and a block.
